cases.raw:
French toast recipe. Use day or so old challah bread so it's kinda firm. Slice into thick pieces and let sit to dry out.\
Heat heavy 1 cup cream and 2 cups whole milk till around 135 (warm) on low. make sure to stir frequently to prevent it from burning in the bottom.\
Wisk 4 egg yolks with 1/2 cup of sugar and 1 tbsp of cinnamon and a pinch of salt (I like sea salt for this). Once dairy is heated temper the yolks to form a custard (slowly pour in a little to begin with whisking to not cook the eggs) continue until all is mixed. Let cool a little but stay lukewarm\
Heat a pan on mid-low and melt some butter. Dunk bread in custard for 15 seconds per side (the heat makes it soak in really fast and too much time will make it fall apart). Gently cook over mid low heat /low to prevent burning. Flip once brown. Keep under a towel to stay hot. Serve with warm Vermont maple syrup, cinnamon and sugar, berries and powdered sugar\
I like this French toast bc it makes the bread rly soft and kinda mushy.

components.title: Bread Preparation
steps: Slice challah bread into thick pieces and let sit to dry out.

components.title: Custard Base
steps: Heat heavy cream and whole milk on low to around 135, stirring frequently to prevent burning on the bottom.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar, cinnamon, and sea salt.
Temper the yolks once the dairy is heated by slowly pouring in a little dairy at first while whisking to avoid cooking the eggs, then continue until all is mixed.
Let the custard cool a little while staying lukewarm.

components.title: Cooking and Serving
steps: Heat a pan on mid-low and melt butter.
Dunk Bread Preparation in Custard Base for 15 seconds per side.
Gently cook over mid-low heat or low to prevent burning.
Flip once brown.
Keep under a towel to stay hot.
Serve with warm Vermont maple syrup, cinnamon, sugar, berries, and powdered sugar.

cases.raw: Shakshuka for 4. 2 cups cherry tomatoes, three cloves garlic, one bell pepper, two yellow onions, 2 cup of tomato sauce, and eight eggs. Diced onion, bell pepper, chopped garlic, sauté in olive oil till translucent seasoning with salt and pepper the onions and bell pepper add garlic while it sautéing sliced cherry tomatoes in half the long way add garlic after onions are translucent add a teaspoon of paprika and 2 pinches of cumin, add cherry tomatoes, cover, and let cook until mushy then press out all the juices add in tomato sauce mix and let simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Crack egg into a cup use a spoon to make a divot in the sauce and pour the egg in there. Repeat until all eggs are used cover poach until egg whites are cooked and yolk is still runny about 3 minutes.  Alternatively, you can turn on the boiler and cook the eggs under there. Serve with toast and feta cheese.

components.title: Vegetable Base
ingredients: 2 cups cherry tomatoes, sliced in half the long way
steps: Sauté the diced onion and bell pepper in olive oil until translucent, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Add the chopped garlic while sautéing after onions are translucent.
Add 1 teaspoon of paprika, 2 pinches of cumin, and the sliced cherry tomatoes.
Cover and let cook until mushy, then press out all the juices.

components.title: Shakshuka Sauce and Eggs
steps: Add in the tomato sauce, mix, and let simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
Crack an egg into a cup, use a spoon to make a divot in the sauce, and pour the egg in there.
Repeat until all eggs are used.
Cover and poach until egg whites are cooked and yolk is still runny, about 3 minutes. Alternatively, turn on the broiler and cook the eggs under there.
Serve with toast and feta cheese.

cases.raw: Blanche 2 cups of kale per person going to need ice water boil water season with salt add kale cook until it starts to wet. Add to ice water. Move it around cool it down squeeze out all the water. Add it to a blender with a quarter cup of olive oil quarter cup Parmesan cheese, two cloves of garlic, pinch of salt and a little chili oil or clabbering chilies or red pepper flakes if you want spice blend till smooth add to a pan heat up boil pasta add pasta to the sauce mix with 1 tablespoon of cubed butter cold butter until glossy add to a pan and top with kale chips and Parmesan crisp Parmesan crisp is done by taking a baking sheet, put in a piece of parchment paper on it and shaving fresh Parmesan on it cooking the oven for about five minutes until it’s crispy. Kale chips are going to be take some kale top with some olive oil, salt and pepper put in the oven till crispy.

provider.title: Blanched Kale Pasta with Kale Chips and Parmesan Crisps

components.title: Parmesan Crisps
steps: Take a baking sheet and put a piece of parchment paper on it.
Shave fresh Parmesan on it.
Cook in the oven for about five minutes until it is crispy.

components.title: Kale Chips
steps: Take kale and top with some olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Put in the oven until crispy.

components.title: Blanched Kale Puree
ingredients: Chili oil or Calabrian chilies or red pepper flakes (optional)
steps: Prepare an ice water bath.
Boil water, season with salt, add kale, and cook until it starts to wilt.
Add to ice water, move it around to cool it down, and squeeze out all the water.

Add the kale to a blender with a quarter cup of olive oil, a quarter cup of Parmesan cheese, two cloves of garlic, a pinch of salt, and a little chili oil or Calabrian chilies or red pepper flakes if you want spice.
Blend until smooth.

components.title: Pasta and Sauce Assembly
steps: Add Blanched Kale Puree to a pan and heat up.
Boil water in a separate pot and add pasta, cooking until done.
Add pasta to the sauce, mix with 1 tablespoon of cubed cold butter until glossy.
Add to a pan and top with Kale Chips and Parmesan Crisps.

yield.evidence: Blanche 2 cups of kale per person

prepMinutes.evidence: Blanche kale, prepare ice bath, blend ingredients, set up chips and crisps.

cookMinutes.evidence: Boil kale, cook pasta, bake parmesan crisps for about five minutes and bake kale chips.

totalMinutes.evidence: Active prep combined with boiling and oven time.

cuisine.evidence: Parmesan cheese, pasta, chili oil or Calabrian chilies.
